This industry group retails automotive fuels (e.g., gasoline, diesel, alternative fuels) and oils, optionally with convenience store items, repair services, or automotive parts/accessories. Includes gasoline stations with and without convenience stores, and truck stops.
This industry group retails heating oil, liquefied petroleum (LP) gas, and other fuels via direct selling (home delivery).

formal_name: Clothing, Clothing Accessories, Shoe, and Jewelry Retailers
description: This subsector retails new clothing, clothing accessories, shoes, jewelry, luggage, and leather goods.

This industry group retails general or specialized lines of new clothing and clothing accessories, e.g., hats, caps, costume jewelry, gloves, handbags, ties, wigs, toupees, and belts. Basic alterations may also be provided.
This industry group retails all types of new footwear (excluding hosiery and specialty sports footwear).

formal_name: Jewelry, Luggage, and Leather Goods Retailers
description: This industry group retails new jewelry (excluding costume jewelry), sterling/plated silverware, watches, and clocks. It also retails new luggage, briefcases, and trunks, often with a general line of leather items (excluding leather apparel).

formal_name: Sporting Goods, Hobby, Musical Instrument, Book, and Miscellaneous Retailers
description: This subsector retails specialized lines of merchandise including new sporting goods, toys, games, hobby supplies, sewing supplies, musical instruments, books, and various other miscellaneous goods like flowers, office supplies, gifts, used merchandise, pets, and tobacco products.

formal_name: Sporting Goods, Hobby, and Musical Instrument Retailers

formal_name: Office Supplies, Stationery, and Gift Retailers
description: This industry group retails new office supplies, stationery, school supplies, gifts, novelty merchandise, souvenirs, and curios. It may combine sales of office equipment, furniture, and supplies, optionally with new computers.
This industry group retails used merchandise, antiques, and secondhand goods (excluding motor vehicles, parts, tires, and mobile homes). It includes auction-based retailing of used merchandise.

This industry group retails miscellaneous specialized lines of merchandise (excluding motor vehicles, building materials, food, furniture, general merchandise, health/personal care, gasoline/fuel, clothing, jewelry, sporting goods, books, florists, office supplies, gifts, used merchandise, pets, art, and mobile homes). This subsector provides rail transportation for passengers or cargo using railroad rolling stock. Operations include extensive networks for long distances or short local lines. Excludes scenic/sightseeing rail and urban transit systems.
This industry group operates railroads (excluding street, commuter rail, urban rapid transit, and scenic trains) for transporting passengers and/or cargo. Includes line-haul and short-line railroads.

This subsector provides water transportation of passengers and cargo using watercraft like ships, barges, and boats. It is divided into deep sea/coastal/Great Lakes transportation and inland water transportation, reflecting differences in equipment.

formal_name: Deep Sea, Coastal, and Great Lakes Water Transportation
description: This industry group provides deep sea, coastal, Great Lakes, and St. Lawrence Seaway water transportation of cargo or passengers. It includes coastal/Great Lakes barge transportation.

This industry group provides general freight trucking, handling a wide variety of palletized commodities in containers or van trailers. It includes local and long-distance services, offering network activities like pick-up, sorting, line-haul, and delivery.

This subsector includes diverse passenger transportation activities, e.g., urban transit, chartered/school/interurban bus, and taxis. Activities are distinguished by factors like vehicle types, routes, and schedules, separating scheduled from nonscheduled services.

This industry group operates local/suburban passenger transit systems over regular routes and schedules within metropolitan areas. It utilizes various modes like light rail, commuter rail, subways, streetcars, buses, and other motor vehicles.

formal_name: Bus and Other Motor Vehicle Transit Systems
description: Bus and Other Motor Vehicle Transit Systems
This industry group provides bus passenger transportation over regular routes and on regular schedules, primarily outside a single metropolitan area.

This industry group provides passenger transportation by automobile or van not on regular routes/schedules, and specialty/luxury services via limousine or luxury sedan, generally reserved. It includes taxicab owner/operators, fleet operators, and ridesharing/ride-hailing services.
This industry group provides buses and other motor vehicles to transport pupils to/from school or employees to/from work.
This industry group provides buses for charter, meeting customers' road transportation needs without operating over fixed routes or regular schedules.

formal_name: Other Transit and Ground Passenger Transportation
description: This industry group provides ground passenger transportation (excluding urban transit, interurban/rural bus, taxi/limousine, school/employee bus, charter bus). This subsector uses transportation equipment for recreation and entertainment, focusing on local activities with same-day returns, distinct from efficient place-to-place transport. It's separated by mode: land, water, and other (e.g., air, cable cars).

This industry group provides scenic and sightseeing transportation on land, e.g., sightseeing buses/trolleys, steam train excursions, and horse-drawn rides. Services are typically local with same-day return.

This industry group provides scenic and sightseeing transportation on water, e.g., airboat operations, excursion boats, charter fishing boat services, harbor sightseeing tours, and dinner cruises. Services are usually local with same-day return.

This industry group provides scenic and sightseeing transportation (excluding land and water), e.g., aerial cable cars, helicopter rides, gliders, aerial tramways, and hot air balloon rides. Services are local with same-day return.

This subsector provides services supporting transportation, including air traffic control, marine cargo handling, and motor vehicle towing, categorized by the mode serviced. These services can be for carriers or the general public.

This subsector primarily provides mail services under a universal service obligation, including collecting, processing, and delivering letters and small parcels, often with mechanized sorting and transportation. It distinguishes from courier services not under such an obligation.

This industry group provides mail services under a universal service obligation, including acceptance, collection, processing, and delivery of letters, printed matter, or mailable packages. It may also offer parcel and express delivery.

This subsector provides intercity, local, or international delivery of parcels and documents (including express delivery) without a universal service obligation. Services involve point-to-point pick-up and delivery, typically for small items, often utilizing mechanized sorting and a network of operations.

This industry group provides air, surface, or combined-mode courier and express delivery services for parcels and documents, without a universal service obligation. Services operate between metropolitan areas, urban centers, or internationally, with local pick-up and delivery.

This industry group provides local messenger and delivery services for small items within a single metropolitan or urban area. Services are generally point-to-point pick-up and delivery, not part of intercity courier networks, e.g., grocery or restaurant meal delivery.

This subsector operates warehousing and storage facilities for general merchandise, refrigerated goods, and other products. Establishments provide secure storage and may offer logistics services like labeling, inventory control, and packaging, but storage is always the primary service.

This industry group operates warehousing and storage facilities for general merchandise, refrigerated goods, and bulk farm products. Establishments provide secure storage and may offer logistics services, but do not sell the goods handled.

This sector produces and distributes information/cultural products, provides transmission/distribution means, and processes data. Key areas include motion pictures, sound recordings, publishing (including software), broadcasting, telecommunications, computing infrastructure, and information services like libraries and web search portals.

formal_name: Motion Picture and Sound Recording Industries
description: This subsector produces and distributes motion pictures and sound recordings, involving complex processes from contracting performers to creating content and providing technical postproduction services. Distribution often targets exhibitors rather than traditional wholesale/retail channels.

This industry group produces and/or distributes motion pictures, videos, television programs, or commercials; exhibits motion pictures; and provides postproduction/related services, e.g., editing, film processing, animation, and special effects.

This subsector publishes newspapers, magazines, books, directories, and software, issuing copyrighted works in various formats (print, electronic, online). Activities include design, editing, marketing, and distribution, with software publishing included for its intellectual product creation process.

formal_name: Newspaper, Periodical, Book, and Directory Publishers
description: This industry group publishes newspapers, magazines, books, directories, and other works, typically possessing copyrights. Activities involve content creation (news, articles), editing, design, advertising sales, and distribution in print or electronic formats.

This industry group publishes software, performing operations like designing, developing, providing documentation, assisting in installation, and supporting purchasers. Establishments may design and develop, or only publish, distributing through subscriptions or downloads.

This subsector creates or acquires and then broadcasts/distributes content via radio, television, media streaming, or social networks. Establishments operate broadcasting stations, networks, and supply information like news reports, generating revenue from advertising, subscriptions, or content sales.

This industry group operates radio or television broadcasting stations for programming and transmission to the public. Programming may originate in-studio, from an affiliated network, or external sources.

formal_name: Media Streaming Distribution Services, Social Networks, and Other Media Networks and Content Providers
description: This industry group provides media streaming distribution, operates social network sites, manages media broadcasting/cable television networks, and supplies information (news, articles, pictures) to media. They distribute textual, audio, and/or video content, generating revenue from advertising, subscriptions, or sales.

This industry group operates/provides access to owned/leased transmission facilities/infrastructure for wired/wireless telecommunications services (excluding satellite). It also covers direct mail, advertising material distribution, and other advertising support.

This industry provides advertising services (excluding advertising agencies, public relations, media buying, media representative, display advertising, direct mail, and advertising material distribution services). It includes advertising specialties distribution, sign lettering, display lettering, store window dressing, and merchandise demonstration services.

formal_name: Other Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services
description: This industry group provides professional, scientific, or technical services (excluding legal, accounting, architectural, engineering, design, computer, management, R&D, advertising, market research, photographic, translation, and veterinary services). It includes appraisal, arbitration, commodity inspection, consumer credit counseling, and weather forecasting.

description: This industry systematically gathers, records, tabulates, and presents marketing and public opinion data. It includes broadcast media rating services, political opinion polling, marketing analysis/research, and statistical sampling services.

description: Marketing Research and Public Opinion Polling

This industry translates written material and interprets speech from one language to another, and/or provides sign language services.

This industry group includes holding companies that hold securities for controlling interest or influencing management, and establishments that administer, oversee, and manage other entities of the company/enterprise, undertaking strategic planning and decision-making.

This industry includes legal entities (holding companies) holding securities for controlling interest/influencing management, and establishments (excluding government) administering/overseeing/managing other company entities, undertaking strategic/organizational planning and decision-making.

formal_name: Administrative and Support and Waste Management and Remediation Services
description: This sector provides routine support activities for other organizations, including office administration, personnel placement, document preparation, security, cleaning, and waste disposal services, typically on a contract basis. It covers both administrative support and waste management functions.

This subsector provides activities supporting the day-to-day operations of other organizations, specializing in functions like general management, personnel administration, clerical work, and cleaning. Services are typically contract- or fee-based, and include travel arrangement.
This industry group provides day-to-day office administrative services, e.g., financial planning, billing, recordkeeping, personnel, physical distribution, and logistics, on a contract or fee basis.

This industry provides a range of day-to-day office administrative services on a contract/fee basis, e.g., financial planning, billing, recordkeeping, personnel, physical distribution, and logistics, without providing operating staff for complete business operations.

This industry group provides operating staff for a combination of support services within a client's facilities, e.g., janitorial, maintenance, trash disposal, security, mail routing, and reception, without managing the client's core business.

This industry provides operating staff for a combination of support services within a client's facilities, e.g., janitorial, maintenance, trash disposal, guard/security, mail routing, and reception, without responsibility for the client's core business. It includes private jail services.

This industry group lists employment vacancies, refers/places applicants, provides executive search/recruitment, and supplies temporary workers to clients. It also offers human resources and human resource management services to businesses/households.

formal_name: Employment Placement Agencies and Executive Search Services
description: This industry lists employment vacancies, recruits, refers, or places applicants, and/or provides executive search, recruitment, and placement services for executive/senior management positions. The individuals placed are not employees of the agencies.

This industry supplies workers to clients' businesses for limited periods to supplement the workforce. Individuals are employees of the temporary help service, but direct supervision is at the client's site.

This industry provides human resources and HR management services to clients in a co-employment relationship, specializing in payroll, payroll tax, benefits administration, workers' compensation, and HR administration.

This industry group performs ongoing routine business support functions for clients on a contract/fee basis or for other establishments within the same enterprise. It includes document preparation, telephone call centers, private mail services, copy shops, collection agencies, and credit bureaus.

This industry writes letters/resumes, edits/proofreads documents, performs typing/word processing/desktop publishing, and provides stenography (excluding court reporting), transcription, and other secretarial services.

This industry operates call centers that initiate or receive communications via telephone, facsimile, email for promoting products/services, taking orders, soliciting contributions, or providing information/assistance. Services are on behalf of clients or for other establishments of the same enterprise.

formal_name: Telemarketing Bureaus and Other Contact Centers
description: Telemarketing Bureaus and Other Contact Centers

This industry provides mailbox rental/postal/mailing services (excluding direct mail advertising), photocopying/duplicating/blueprinting/document copying (excluding printing), and a range of office support services (excluding printing), e.g., facsimile, word processing, on-site PC rental, and office product sales.

formal_name: Other Business Service Centers (including Copy Shops)
description: Other Business Service Centers (including Copy Shops)
This industry collects payments for claims and remits collected payments to clients, e.g., account/delinquent account collection services and tax collection services on contract/fee basis.
This industry compiles information (e.g., credit/employment histories) and provides it to financial institutions, retailers, and others to evaluate individuals'/businesses' creditworthiness.

This industry provides business support services (excluding secretarial, telephone answering/telemarketing, private mail, document copying, debt collection, credit reporting, repossession, and court reporting). It includes address bar coding, charitable fundraising campaign organization, and mail presorting.

This industry group provides travel arrangement and reservation services, including travel agency services, tour operation, and other related services like hotel/restaurant reservations and ticket sales for various events.
This industry acts as agents in selling travel, tour, and accommodation services to the general public and commercial clients.
This industry arranges and assembles tours, which are sold through travel agencies or other tour operators. It includes travel and wholesale tour operators.

formal_name: Other Travel Arrangement and Reservation Services
description: This industry provides travel arrangement and reservation services (excluding travel agencies and tour operators). It includes condominium time-share exchange, road/travel services automobile clubs, convention/visitors bureaus, ticket agencies (amusement, sports, theatrical), and reservation services (airline, car rental, hotel, restaurant).

description: All Other Travel Arrangement and Reservation Services

This industry group provides investigation, guard, and armored car services. It includes detective work, personal background checks, guard/patrol services, money/receipt transit protection, selling/installing/repairing security systems, and remote monitoring of alarms.

formal_name: Investigation, Guard, and Armored Car Services
description: This industry provides investigation, detective, and personal background check services; guard and patrol services (e.g., bodyguard, guard dog, parking security); and armored car services for picking up/delivering money/valuables.

formal_name: Investigation and Personal Background Check Services
description: Investigation and Personal Background Check Services

This industry sells security systems (e.g., burglar/fire alarms, locking devices, safes, security vaults) with installation, repair, or monitoring services, and/or remotely monitors electronic security alarm systems.

This industry group provides services to buildings and dwellings, e.g., exterminating/pest control, janitorial services (interior cleaning), landscaping, carpet/upholstery cleaning, and other services like exterior cleaning, chimney cleaning, and pool maintenance.
This industry exterminates and controls birds, mosquitoes, rodents, termites, and other insects/pests (excluding for crop/forestry production). It includes fumigation services.

This industry cleans building interiors, interiors of transportation equipment (e.g., aircraft, rail cars, ships), and/or windows. It includes custodial, housekeeping, maid, and washroom sanitation services.

This industry provides landscape care/maintenance services and/or installs trees, shrubs, plants, lawns, or gardens. It may also include designing landscape plans and constructing features like walkways, retaining walls, decks, and fences.
This industry cleans and dyes used rugs, carpets, and upholstery.

formal_name: Other Services to Buildings and Dwellings
description: This industry provides services to buildings and dwellings (excluding exterminating/pest control, janitorial, landscaping care, and carpet/upholstery cleaning). Examples include building exterior cleaning (excluding sandblasting, window cleaning), swimming pool cleaning, chimney cleaning, and drain/gutter cleaning.

formal_name: Other Services to Buildings and Dwellings
description: Other Services to Buildings and Dwellings

This industry group provides day-to-day business and other organizational support services (excluding office administrative, facilities support, employment, business support, travel arrangement, security/investigation, and building services). It includes packaging, labeling, convention/trade show organizing, bartering, and traffic control.
This industry packages client-owned materials, including labeling and/or imprinting the package. Services include apparel/textile folding, blister packaging, and gift wrapping.
This industry organizes, promotes, and/or manages events like business and trade shows, conventions, conferences, and meetings, whether or not they manage the facilities.

This industry provides day-to-day business and organizational support services (excluding office administrative, facilities support, employment, business support, travel arrangement, security/investigation, building services, packaging/labeling, and convention/trade show organizing). Examples include bartering, flagging (traffic control), bottle exchanges, inventory taking, and lumber grading services.

This subsector collects, treats, and disposes of waste materials, including local hauling, operating recovery facilities for recyclables, remediation services (e.g., hazardous material cleanup), and septic pumping. Excludes long-distance waste hauling and municipal sewer systems.

This industry group collects and/or hauls hazardous, nonhazardous, and/or recyclable waste materials within a local area. It also operates waste transfer stations and may involve identification, treatment, packaging, and labeling of hazardous waste.

This industry collects and/or hauls hazardous, nonhazardous, and/or recyclable waste materials within a local area. It also operates waste transfer stations and may identify, treat, package, and label waste for transport.

This industry group operates waste treatment/disposal facilities (excluding sewer systems), or combines local collection/hauling with operating such facilities. It includes waste combustors/incinerators, solid waste landfills, and compost dumps.

This industry operates waste treatment/disposal facilities (excluding sewer systems) or combines local collection/hauling with operating such facilities. It includes waste combustors/incinerators, solid waste landfills, and compost dumps.

description: Other Nonhazardous Waste Treatment and Disposal

formal_name: Remediation and Other Waste Management Services
description: This industry group provides remediation and other waste management services (excluding waste collection, treatment, disposal, and materials recovery). It includes cleanup of contaminated sites, integrated mine reclamation, asbestos/lead paint abatement, septic tank pumping, and sewer cleaning.

This industry remediates/cleans up contaminated buildings, mine sites, soil, or ground water. It includes integrated mine reclamation (demolition, soil remediation, wastewater treatment, hazardous material removal, contouring, revegetation) and asbestos, lead paint, and other toxic material abatement.

This industry operates facilities for separating/sorting recyclable materials from nonhazardous waste streams (garbage) and/or for sorting commingled recyclables (paper, plastics, used beverage cans, metals) into distinct categories.

This industry provides waste management services (excluding waste collection, treatment/disposal, remediation, materials recovery facilities, and waste management consulting services). It includes septic tank pumping, portable toilet rental/servicing, beach cleaning, and sewer/storm basin cleanout.
